text:
ashley: quick heads-up, after yesterday's kernel-pick change we observed a regression on mixtral-mqa runs. throughput down ~12% for long-seq tails, and p99 token latency up ~18%. attaching short profiler snippet below. :frowning_face:

prateek: ugh. which kernel was rolled? any change to kv layout or head mapping? :eyes:

ashley: kernel-picker swapped to cudnn-optimized attention v3.5 for speed, but it looks like kv slot packing behavior changed. no config edits to model, but the runtime now selects 'packed-rows' kernel for certain head/dim combos.

maria: can you paste the profile? also repro command you ran?

ashley: sure: 
```
./bench_runner --model mixtral-mqa-8b --mode streaming --batch 4 --seq_prefill 512 --seq_gen 1024 --num_tokens 512 --concurrency 32
```
 profiler excerpt (nvtx timeline):
```
[profile] stage: attn_kernel_packed_rows            62.4% time
[profile] stage: kv_page_eviction                 9.8% time
[profile] stage: mem_copy_heads                    7.1% time
[profile] stage: kernel_dispatch_overhead          6.3% time
[profile] stage: other                             14.4% time
```

prateek: kv_page_eviction 9.8% is suspicious for paged-kv mode. did num_key_value_heads change from model mapping?

ashley: model metadata says num_key_value_heads=64, but the runtime (kernel v3.5) expects 32 for that kernel path, so it splits into two fragments -> extra copies and page churn. looks like RoPE scaling bumped effective head dim (rotary freq) and triggered the alternate kernel path.

kai: indy thought: MQA vs GQA mapping mismatch causes frag. if kernel assumes 32 kv-head packing but model provides 64, runtime fragments into half-slabs; on paged layout that makes slots non-contiguous and increases evict churn.

maria: can we force the kernel hint to use 'kv_packed_contiguous' or fall back to the older kernel until we fix picker heuristics?

ashley: tried local patch: set KERNEL_HINT=force_old for that model id -> throughput restored to baseline but token latency slightly higher for short sequences. hacky but useful as mitigation.

prateek: good interim fix. long-term: update kernel-picker logic to consider num_key_value_heads and rope_scale thresholds before selecting packed-rows. also add a check to avoid splitting kv heads when paged-kv is enabled.

kai: Agreed. I'll open an RFC for picker heuristics with the following proposed changes:
- include num_key_value_heads in kernel selection score
- add penalty for splits when paged-kv=true
- prefer legacy contiguous-kv when seq_prefill > 256 and kv_slot_frag_estimate > 0.2
- expose runtime flag KV_SLOT_SIZE (default 128 -> allow bump to 256 for MQA)

maria: for immediate triage we should run a small matrix of bench jobs and gather:
- varying num_key_value_heads: 32,48,64
- kv_slot_size: 128,256
- kernel_hint: v3.2 (legacy), v3.5 (packed)
- seq_prefill: 128,512,1024
collect: throughput, p50/p95/p99 token latency, nvprof stage breakdown, eviction count heatmap.

deploy-bot: bench-matrix queued: job-id 2245-bench-rc1 (6x GPUs, 48h max). will post artifacts to /bench/artifacts/2245-bench-rc1 once done. :gear:

ashley: thanks. i'll attach perf traces and a small frag-heatmap (hot pages per slot) to the job. initial hypothesis: RoPE scaling changed attention kernel decision boundary, which with MQA head counts causes fragmentation; fix in picker + small increase in kv_slot_size should recover throughput without sacrificing latency for short seqs.

prateek: add a microprofile that forces random short/long prefix mix to surface any tail regressions. also test on Llama/mistral variants to ensure it's not mixtral-only.

maria: I'll take ownership of the regression postmortem after bench results land. plan: patch picker + backfill unit test that simulates paged-kv fragmentation (head mismatch) and prevent future rollouts.

kai: cool. for now let's keep the force_old hint active for affected dedicated pools until we have a safe rollout. can someone file a config flag PR with a monitored kill-switch?

ashley: filing PR now for the runtime flag + telemetry to emit kv_fragmentation_score per request. will link the PR here. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: PR created: https://rwd/infra/pulls/1427 - includes flag KV_FORCE_LEGACY_FOR_MQA and telemetry metric kv_fragmentation_score.

prateek: perfect. once bench artifacts show brown/green numbers we'll schedule a kernel-picker fix for next week's runtime patch.

maria: noted. assigning postmortem and follow-ups to infra-ops and eng-runtime. thanks everyone. :rocket:
